generations.zh: 轻量档：30B 总参 / 3B 激活 MoE，面向单机与低延迟 agent；官方给出 1M 上下文。
generations.en: Lightweight tier: 30B total / 3B active MoE, aimed at single-machine and low-latency agents; the official page states a 1M context.

generations.zh: 中档：120B 总参 / 12B 激活，适合多卡推理与较复杂 agent 工作流。
generations.en: Mid tier: 120B total / 12B active, suited to multi-GPU inference and more complex agent workflows.

generations.zh: 旗舰：550B 总参 / 55B 激活，面向大集群与最高质量档；本地部署门槛很高。
generations.en: Flagship: 550B total / 55B active, aimed at large clusters and the highest-quality tier; the local-deployment bar is very high.

licenses.zh: NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License / OpenMDW-1.1（以模型卡为准）
licenses.en: NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License / OpenMDW-1.1 (per model card)

claims.zh: NVIDIA 官方 Nemotron 页面列出 Lightning 30B-A3B、Super 120B-A12B、Ultra 550B-A55B 三档，并标注 1M 上下文与开放模型许可。
claims.en: NVIDIA’s official Nemotron page lists Lightning 30B-A3B, Super 120B-A12B and Ultra 550B-A55B, with a 1M context and an open-model licence.

positioning.zh: NVIDIA 的开放权重 agent 家族：三档 MoE 覆盖单机到集群，主打长上下文、推理与本地 agent。它的价值不在“又一个开源模型”，而在把 NVIDIA 的推理栈、NIM 与硬件适配绑在一起；如果你不用 NVIDIA 硬件，收益会打折。
positioning.en: NVIDIA’s open-weight agent family: three MoE tiers from a single machine to a cluster, pitched at long context, reasoning and local agents. Its value is not “another open model” but the coupling with NVIDIA’s inference stack, NIM and hardware; without NVIDIA hardware the benefit is smaller.

onSite.zh: 本站尚未收录 Nemotron 的量化对比：三档尺寸跨度大，GGUF 生态与下载量还在早期，未达到本站约 30 万下载的门槛。
onSite.en: No Nemotron quantisation comparison yet: the three tiers span very different sizes and the GGUF ecosystem is still early, below this site’s ~300k-download threshold.
